about.title: Imagine with Love. Create with Companion.
about.storyP1: As die-hard Zelda fans, we wanted to bring the Korok into reality — a little spirit hiding in the city noise, drawing power from nature.
about.storyP2: But Offy is more than soft and cute — she's willful, stubborn, and full of strange ideas. She wears her emotions on the outside.
about.storyP3: You're not just picking a plush — you're picking the her that resonates with you.
